527:t_010:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're really going in with nothing but your bare body!?」

527:t_010:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「As long as my body can move, I'll keep moving forward...!」

527:t_010:7.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「But you don't know how terrifying Mr. Ag is.」

527:t_010:9.en:
$n
「He's not talking about that $$ＡＧ$$, is he...」

527:t_010:10.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Mr. Ag has taken the top seat in $$アマルガム$$. This is a revolution within the organization called $$アマルガム$$.」

527:t_010:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード$$ has become the leader of $$アマルガム$$...」

527:t_010:13.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It works in our favor as well.」

527:t_010:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Because we've found a way to win a decisive victory over $$アマルガム$$, an organization that ran organically and was thought never to be destroyed.」

527:t_010:15.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「But your hopes will come crumbling down! Behold this!」

527:t_011:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「No... the details are different!」

527:t_011:2.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「This AS... it's called the ARX-8.」

527:t_011:3.en:
$n
「A successor to the $$アーバレスト$$!?」

527:t_012:3.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hahahahaha, too bad! And so $$ミスリル$$'s last hope was blasted into teeny-tiny bits by the hand of the great $$ゲイツ$$!」

527:t_013:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hey, come on! It's a great scene, so get into it more!」

527:t_013:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can fight without an AS!」

527:t_013:2.en:
???
「Your words say one thing, but I can see you're panicking.」

527:t_013:8.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...This reminds me of when we met again in Afghanistan, $$相良$$ $$宗介$$.」

527:t_013:9.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I win. With your heart stolen by that girl, you're full of openings.」

527:t_013:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「Major... What is the meaning of this...」

527:t_013:11.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「As you can see. I've become one of $$アマルガム$$.」

527:t_013:12.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I will eliminate, with everything I have, anyone who stands against $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ and the organization.」

527:t_013:14.en:
$$カレン$$
「There must be some reason... like you infiltrated the enemy to throw them into confusion from within! Right!?」

527:t_013:15.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I'm afraid it's not the decoy operation you people imagine.」

527:t_013:16.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I became your enemy of my own free will.」

527:t_013:18.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「$$相良$$ $$宗介$$. If you resist, I will order you shot without hesitation.」

527:t_013:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I have one question. Is $$千鳥$$ here?」

527:t_013:21.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「But your trip is wasted. That girl and Mr. Ag... $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ will be pulling out of here shortly.」

527:t_013:22.en:
???
「Before that, I think I'll at least witness your end.」

527:t_013:24.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's been a while, $$相良$$ $$宗介$$.」

527:t_013:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no business with you. Let me see $$千鳥$$.」

527:t_013:26.en:
$$レナード$$
「...You're as unpleasant as ever. You don't understand a thing, yet you shout like that.」

527:t_013:27.en:
$$レナード$$
「Why don't you recognize your own arrogance?」

527:t_013:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「Like I care. Hand over $$千鳥$$.」

527:t_013:29.en:
$$レナード$$
「Dear me... As I thought, there's no conversing with you.」

527:t_013:30.en:
$$レナード$$
「Mr. K... I leave his fate to you.」

527:t_013:34.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You will die here, $$相良$$ $$宗介$$.」

527:t_013:35.en:
$$宗介$$
(That look, that voice... he means it. The man I thought of as a father is seriously trying to kill me...)

527:t_013:36.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「OK! Mr. K has given the go-ahead!」

527:t_014:2.en:
$n
「Just go, $$宗介$$! Now that we know $$千鳥$$ is here, there's only one thing left to do!」

527:t_014:4.en:
$n
「You owe me a large Galaxy Ramen.」

527:t_014:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll even permit you to add the marinated egg.」

527:t_014:6.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Quit playing your corny friendship make-believe!」

527:t_014:9.en:
$$宗介$$
(What the Major is thinking can wait...! Right now... I'm getting out of here!)

527:t_015:0.en:
$$カリーニン$$
($$相良$$ $$宗介$$... Even you people can't overturn this situation.)

527:t_015:1.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(If such a thing were to happen, it would be proof that this world itself is wrong.)

527:t_016:2.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Buhahahahahaha! From the look of you, the mission failed!」

527:t_017:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Just give up already! Bottom of the ninth, two outs, nobody on base! You're 100 runs behind!」

527:t_017:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$マデューカス$$... Put communications on an open channel.」
